title: [GMCP 203.021.01] Contract: Local MCP gateway, reverse proxy, and aggregation plane
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-021-01. Translate the mastery target into a normative clause and behavior table. Pin source revisions and hashes; define canonical APIs and data models, compatibility and deprecation decisions, threat model, measurable SLO or resource budgets, positive and negative fixtures, and immutable evidence locations. Resolve every ambiguity before implementation. Vector outcome: GMCP exposes many local or remote servers as one policy-enforced endpoint while preserving original server identity, capabilities, schemas, errors, progress, cancellation, subscriptions and trace context. Routing and transformation are deterministic; backpressure, quotas and failure isolation prevent one backend from harming others; and direct-versus-gateway differential tests prove no semantic loss. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
